query:
SELECT 
  CASE attendeeId 
    WHEN '76678269091' THEN 'Adam Binks (KPMG)'
    WHEN '4956154' THEN 'Jules Anderson (Gilead)'
  END as delegateName,
  m.timeSlot,
  s.companyName as sponsor,
  m.id as meetingId
FROM meetings m
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE m.attendeeId IN ('76678269091','4956154')
ORDER BY m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot;
